import pytest
from unittest import mock

# Assume the function _worker is defined above this test code in the same file.
# Example implementation (for reference):
# def _worker(job: dict) -> None:
#     with SLOTS:
#         run_job(job)

class DummyContext:
    def __init__(self):
        self.entered = False
        self.exited = False
        self.exit_args = None

    def __enter__(self):
        self.entered = True
        return self

    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc, tb):
        self.exited = True
        self.exit_args = (exc_type, exc, tb)
        # Propagate exception if any
        return False


def test_worker_calls_run_job_and_context_manager(monkeypatch):
    dummy_ctx = DummyContext()
    mock_run_job = mock.Mock()

    # Patch the global names used inside _worker
    monkeypatch.setattr(__name__, "SLOTS", dummy_ctx, raising=False)
    monkeypatch.setattr(__name__, "run_job", mock_run_job, raising=False)

    job = {"id": 1, "payload": "data"}
    _worker(job)

    # Verify context manager was entered and exited without error
    assert dummy_ctx.entered, "SLOTS context manager was not entered"
    assert dummy_ctx.exited, "SLOTS context manager was not exited"
    assert dummy_ctx.exit_args == (None, None, None), "Context manager exit args unexpected"

    # Verify run_job was called exactly once with the provided job
    mock_run_job.assert_called_once_with(job)


def test_worker_propagates_exception_and_exits_context(monkeypatch):
    dummy_ctx = DummyContext()
    mock_run_job = mock.Mock(side_effect=RuntimeError("boom"))

    monkeypatch.setattr(__name__, "SLOTS", dummy_ctx, raising=False)
    monkeypatch.setattr(__name__, "run_job", mock_run_job, raising=False)

    job = {"id": 2, "payload": "other"}

    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="boom"):
        _worker(job)

    # Context manager should still be exited even when an exception occurs
    assert dummy_ctx.entered, "SLOTS context manager was not entered"
    assert dummy_ctx.exited, "SLOTS context manager was not exited"
    exc_type, exc, tb = dummy_ctx.exit_args
    assert exc_type is RuntimeError
    assert isinstance(exc, RuntimeError)
    assert str(exc) == "boom"
